title: HackSprint 2026: 8-Hour Innovation Marathon
description: Build something in 24 hours with a team of up to four. Mentors from local startups are on hand, there is food all night, and the top three projects win cash prizes and internship fast-passes.

title: Echoes: Unplugged Open Mic Night
description: Sing, strum or spit bars. Sign up on the night for a five-minute slot, or just come to cheer. Acoustic instruments are provided.

title: IPU Inter-Department Football Championship
description: Eight departments, one trophy. Group matches run all week and the final is under floodlights. Teams register through their department rep.

title: Golden Hour Photo Walk & Gallery Exhibit
description: Take a guided golden-hour walk across campus, then print your best shot and hang it in the gallery the same evening.

title: Corporate Ready: Resume Clinic & Corporate Mock Interviews
description: Bring a printed resume and get one-on-one feedback from recruiters and alumni. Covers formats, project descriptions and LinkedIn profiles.

title: CodeLabs: Building Your First Machine Learning Model
description: A hands-on session where you train your first model in Python. No prior ML knowledge needed; bring a laptop with Python installed.

title: Jashn-e-Diwali: Campus Cultural Fest
description: Dance, drama, rangoli and a food street run by student clubs. Wear traditional clothes and stay for the lamp-lighting finale.

title: Ignite: Annual Startup Pitch Competition
description: Ten student teams pitch to a panel of founders and investors. Network over snacks afterwards and vote for the audience favourite.

title: Mindful Morning: Sunrise Yoga Session
description: A gentle 45-minute session for all levels. Bring a mat and water; mats are available to borrow if you arrive early.

title: Riff-Off: The Ultimate Battle of the Bands
description: Six campus bands, one stage, and a crowd that decides the winner. Gates open at 5:30 PM.

title: Nukkad Natak: Street Play Showcase
description: Short plays on social issues performed in the open, one after another. Walk up, watch and join the discussion after each act.

title: Canvas to Screen: Digital Painting Masterclass
description: Learn layers, brushes and colour theory on a drawing tablet with a visiting illustrator. Tablets are provided; seats are limited.
